Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest. The Gateway's scheduler rejected the job because it has no credentials, so nothing is scheduled yet. I haven't changed any gateway config to work around that.

The job I was trying to create is:
- **When:** every Monday at 08:00 America/Chicago, starting Monday 19 October 2026.
- **Where:** posted here in #coastal-team as my reply.
- **Covers:** the previous week in #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items from those two channels.
- **Limits:** only those two channels are read. Finance figures such as rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoice amounts and payment terms are left out, with a pointer to Anselm or June instead. Direct messages are not used.

Once someone with gateway access fixes the scheduler credentials, ask me again and I'll set it up. Until then, no digest will post on Monday.
